name: Bohr Model and Atomic Spectra
methods: Set Coulomb force equal to centripetal force
Apply quantization condition L = n hbar
Calculate allowed orbital radii and energy levels
Compute transition wavelengths and photon energies
problem_types: Calculate Lyman, Balmer, and Paschen emission wavelengths
Compute ionization energy of hydrogen-like ions (He+, Li++)
Find orbital speed and transition frequencies
pitfalls: Applying the simple Bohr model directly to multi-electron atoms
Confusing principal quantum number transitions with emitted photon frequencies
Ignoring reduced mass corrections in precision spectroscopy
